_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Draft compiled 2026-09-26 from NDLEA May and July 2026 releases and later Nigerian court reporting. Ten named defendants were arraigned on 10 July 2026 and pleaded not guilty; September bail denial does not establish guilt. The country marker is Nigeria only, tied to alleged historical methamphetamine-production activity there. Mexican nationality is not treated as Mexican operation. NDLEA and later reporting vary name order for Juan Carlos, Omonughwa, and Nwobum; a May apparent Nemecio/Nemecto typo was not propagated as an alias because the July NDLEA charge release gives the canonical full name. No pairwise edges are inferred from joint charges or a collective description of specialists. No precise addresses, routes, current positions, or uncleared portraits are included.
